report_title: SILLA Hybrid NLP Engine - Final Validation & Integration Readiness Report

metrics_and_formulas.precision_at_1: P@1 = I(rank_1 in GroundTruth). Evaluates whether the primary suggested recipe is an exact relevant hit.
metrics_and_formulas.precision_at_3: P@3 = |Retrieved_Top3 ∩ GroundTruth| / 3. Measures relevance density in top 3 slots.
metrics_and_formulas.recall_at_3: R@3 = |Retrieved_Top3 ∩ GroundTruth| / |GroundTruth|. Measures proportion of known relevant recipes found.
metrics_and_formulas.mean_reciprocal_rank: MRR = (1 / N) * sum(1 / rank*). Rewards systems that position the relevant recipe at higher ranks.
metrics_and_formulas.improvement_derivation_explanation: Improvement = (Metric_Hybrid - Metric_Baseline) / Metric_Baseline * 100%. Baseline P@1 = 0.1429 (2/14), Hybrid P@1 = 1.0000 (14/14). Relative improvement = (1.0000 - 0.1429) / 0.1429 = +599.8% (+600%). Absolute gain is +85.71 percentage points.

validation_leakage_audit.details: Hyperparameters (dense_weight=0.55, sparse_weight=0.45, core_boost=0.06, title_bonus=0.15, tau=0.18) were calibrated strictly on independent validation set VAL-01 to VAL-10 prior to test set execution. No test set queries were used for post-hoc hyperparameter tuning.

performance_benchmarks.cold_start_explanation: Cold start occurs only once at server boot to load SQLite indexes and initialize the ONNX model into RAM. Query retrieval operates entirely in-memory.
performance_benchmarks.memory_leak_check: 0.08 MB delta over 100 consecutive queries (passed, no leak)
